summary.text: Father of Dolops, the Danaan leader whom Hector slew when Zeus vouchsafed the prince glory in his rampage — distinct from the son of Laomedon of the same name at the Scaean gates and from the suitors so called from Same and Zacynthus.

story.text: Homer names Clytius only as the father of Dolops among the foremost Danaan leaders whom Hector cut down when the god gave him victory: Asaeus first, and Autonous, and Opites and Dolops son of Clytius, and Opheltius, and Agelaus, and Aesymnus, and Orus, and Hipponous, staunch in fight.
